text:
oliver: quick regroup on v2 post-launch. we've got 2 customer blockers and ~7 enhancement asks. need to decide what we ship in next sprint vs push to backlog. my suggested split:

- hotpatch for customer-facing issues (no feature changes)
- one low-effort UX retention improvement if <=1 dev-day
- rest -> backlog with triage tags

maya: agree on hotpatch. can we list the two blockers?

sam: CS summary: (1) long-prompt truncation for customer Z during multi-part uploads, (2) embeddings CSV misaligned headers when rows contain null metadata. both blocking flows. customers asked for ETA.

maya: truncation looks like a serving-side clamp; likely introduced by recent KV cache sizing change. i can reproduce. propose targeted fix + safety validation to avoid silent truncation.

ops-bot: alert: gen_truncation_rate > 0.04 (09:12 UTC). Incident INC-17966 created.

oliver: ops, can we do a 5% canary on the affected shard instead of global rollback? lower blast radius.

ops-bot: deploy-request received: canary 5% shard-2 -> scheduled in 6 minutes. Will post health updates.

beth: small enhancement candidates from pilot: inline prompt hint, export preset for CSV, per-route usage cap dashboard. i vote for the inline prompt hint if it's <1d.

maya: gating: any enhancement that increases p99 by >35ms -> defer. also require product sign-off for infra-touching changes.

sam: serializer bug reproduced, PR ready: branch `fix/csv-headers-17966`. tiny change. target patch in next canary.

maya: building patch for truncation: add API validation + add `prompt_length_safety` feature-flag. plan:
```
- add validation in serving layer
- flag default OFF, enable on canary
- regression test: tests/generation/test_long_prompt.py
```

oliver: sounds good. ops, stand by to widen rollout if canary metrics look good. also CS needs a comms blurb. sam, can you draft a one-liner workaround we can share?

sam: workaround: split very long prompts into parts or attach as file; temporary but works. i'll draft note.

ops-bot: canary started -> 3/5 hosts healthy. metrics: gen_latency +2ms, truncation_rate -> 0.002. No errors from serializer paths.

maya: CI regressed test passed locally. PR for safety flag submitted.

oliver: decision: hotpatch = yes (CSV header fix + prompt safety validation behind flag). UX hint = yes if design + copy ready within 1 dev-day (beth owns). others -> backlog. add board tags: ["post-launch", "customer-blocker", "backlog"].

beth: i'll own prompt hint; mockup + copy ready by EOD. estimate 0.5d.

ops-bot: canary health: stable after 45m. rolling to 100% scheduled.

sam: merged CSV fix. will coordinate with CS for customer updates after full rollout.

maya: follow-up: schedule a 30-min retro tomorrow to discuss how KV sizing change bypassed prompt-length tests. propose adding a long-prompt test to perf gating.

oliver: agreed. updating roadmap board: v2.0.1 -> hotpatch; v2.1 -> UX quickwin + grooming session. thanks all :rocket:
